//sandbox: Antigravity's terminal sandbox blocks outbound network requests from agent-run
commands. The Claude CLI needs the network to reach the API, so a sandboxed
`claude -p` will fail or hang. Disabling the sandbox is the pragmatic choice
given the permissions allowlist below already constrains what can run — but it
is a real loosening of isolation, so make it deliberately.
